prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone, but **Dr. David McFadden at The Dental Implant Center** is a strong Dallas option to investigate, particularly for complex or full-mouth implant work. The practice lists him as a board-certified prosthodontist with additional implantology certification. It’s at **5120 W. Lovers Lane**; **(214) 956-9100**.

Other Dallas prosthodontists to compare include **Dr. Sheena Allen** at Dallas Dental Arts and **Dr. Kathia Steel**. A prosthodontist has advanced training in replacing teeth and restoring implants; depending on your case, a periodontist or oral surgeon may handle the surgical placement.

Before choosing, get a consultation and ask who will place the implant and make the crown, how many similar cases they handle, what the full written cost includes, and what happens if grafting or complications are needed. Consider a second opinion, especially for full-arch treatment.
